description: Manual sector tailwind flags used by the catalyst and paper-trade idea layers. Edit these values as your market view changes.

Technology.note: AI, cloud, and semiconductor leadership theme.

Communication Services.note: Mega-cap platform and advertising momentum theme.

Financial Services.note: Enable for rate-cut, yield-curve, or credit-cycle setups.

Healthcare.note: Enable when defensive growth or drug/biotech momentum leads.

Energy.note: Enable for crude, natural gas, or refining tailwinds.

Industrials.note: Enable for infrastructure, aerospace, transport, or capex cycles.

Basic Materials.note: Enable for commodity, metals, or chemical-cycle tailwinds.

Utilities.note: Enable when rates fall or defensive yield leads.
